card.name: Patient counseling and word-completing spots
card.fires_on: Words in patient-counseling and dosing-comparison phrases, such as the end of PATIENTS or COUNSELING, 'patient and', and 'take' in instructions. It also fires on 'mill-igram' in glucocorticoid dose tables.
